drafts.name: Process standard refund
drafts.description: Issue refunds for requests made within 30 days of delivery provided order ID or email is provided.
drafts.condition: refund requests within 30 calendar days of the original delivery date as recorded by the carrier [and] Customers must provide either the order ID or the email used at checkout
drafts.rationale: Standard window for customer satisfaction and returns.

drafts.name: Process defective item refund
drafts.description: Issue full refunds for defective items if flagged within 7 days of delivery.
drafts.condition: item is defective on arrival ("DOA") and the customer flagged the defect within 7 days of delivery
drafts.action: refunded at full purchase price including original shipping
drafts.rationale: Ensures customers are not penalized for receiving faulty goods.

drafts.name: Process buyer's remorse return
drafts.description: Refund purchase price minus original shipping for non-defective returns.
drafts.action: refunded at purchase price minus the original shipping fee; return shipping is the customer's responsibility
drafts.rationale: Protects the business from shipping costs on non-fault returns.

drafts.name: Apply restocking fee
drafts.description: Charge a 15% restocking fee for opened, non-defective items.
drafts.action: charge a 15% restocking fee on the item subtotal (not on shipping)
drafts.rationale: Covers costs associated with processing opened inventory.

drafts.name: Issue refund to original payment method
drafts.description: Process refunds within 3 business days of warehouse receipt.
drafts.condition: within 3 business days of receiving the returned item at our warehouse
drafts.action: Refunds are issued to the original payment method
drafts.rationale: Standardizes the speed of financial reimbursement.

drafts.name: Process same-SKU exchange
drafts.description: Provide free shipping for size or color swaps within 30 days.
drafts.condition: Same-SKU exchanges (size or color swap) are free within the 30-day window
drafts.action: we cover return shipping AND replacement shipping
drafts.rationale: Encourages customer retention for simple product swaps.

drafts.name: Process different-SKU exchange
drafts.description: Handle different-SKU exchanges as a refund and a new purchase.
drafts.action: processed as a refund-and-rebuy and the customer pays shipping on the new order
drafts.rationale: Prevents inventory and shipping complexity for different products.

drafts.name: Handle ineligible item remediation
drafts.description: Offer store credit for custom, final sale, digital, or gift card items on a case-by-case basis.
drafts.condition: Custom or personalized items, Final-sale clearance, Digital downloads after first successful download, or Gift cards
drafts.action: the only remediation is store credit on a case-by-case basis at the founder's discretion
drafts.rationale: Protects high-risk or non-returnable inventory categories.

drafts.name: Process order cancellation
drafts.description: Allow full refunds for cancellations before carrier scan.
drafts.condition: Orders can be cancelled... up until the carrier has scanned the package
drafts.rationale: Allows customers to change their minds before shipping begins.

drafts.name: Process damaged-in-transit claim
drafts.description: Require photo evidence within 48 hours for transit damage claims.
drafts.condition: Damaged-in-transit claims [with] Photo evidence of the damaged package and contents... within 48 hours of delivery
drafts.action: Claims older than 48 hours are denied
drafts.rationale: Ensures claims are made within the carrier's valid window.
